group.doc: Point group to transform; empty selects all points

target_position.doc: Centre of the target bounds when no target geometry is wired

target_size.doc: Size of the target bounds when no target geometry is wired

translate.doc: Move the selected points to the justified target anchor

justify_x.doc: Source and target anchor on X

justify_y.doc: Source and target anchor on Y

justify_z.doc: Source and target anchor on Z

justify_to.doc: Target aligns anchors to target bounds; same preserves the source anchor

scale_to_fit.doc: Scale selected points to the target bounding box size

uniform_scale.doc: Use the smallest nondegenerate axis scale on all axes

restore_transform.doc: Reserved; restoring a stored transform is not supported

stash_transform.doc: Reserved; storing the transform is not supported
